author: Megaprojects
description:
Navies worldwide are deploying autonomous submarines that can travel thousands of miles without crews. America's Orca, Australia's Ghost Shark and Britain's Excalibur represent a fundamental shift in underwater warfare. These robots won't replace nuclear submarines but will surround them, creating vast undersea networks for surveillance, mine warfare and strike operations.
